title: Coins and Score
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about points. Coins add to your score, gems are worth more and a rock takes points away, and a heart adds a life. Game-Maker has no extra life at a certain score, so the last level says so plainly. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change what a gem is worth.

box.tagline: Gold does not do much on its own.
box.back: A small explorer in a blue beanie is out collecting. Coins add to the score, gems pay more, and a rock takes a little away. A heart adds a life, which no score can do. Read the signs, press F2 to look at the score, then open the game in Game-Maker and change what a pickup is worth.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Every pickup is a block with a number on it
Made to be copied and taken apart
